body: I'm not sure if this is absolutely correct/clear from a conceptual point of view (tag name ends with ` `, `=` or `]`), although it may work correctly. I'm even less sure about the commented code.

The commented code _would_ work last time I checked, but there were so few occasions where it was useful for the parser, that I likely decided to comment it out.

I honestly wouldn't mind uncommenting this code to fetching them earlier. Less performant at the cost of everyone's sanity in this huge code snippet.

> I'm not sure if this is absolutely correct/clear from a conceptual point of view

The subdivision process is a bit like this. I'm going to immagine an entirely fictitious tag:

| variable | string | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
|`tag` | `dummy=foo option1=bar option_no_value` |
| `tag_beginning` | `dummy=value` |
| `tag_name` | `dummy` |
| `tag_value` | `foo` | Unused in this PR |
| `tag_options` | `option1=bar option_no_value` | Unused in this PR |

I'm going to rebase the PR soon-ish, let's see.
